title: Crystalline Alien Egg
description: A large, glowing pinkish-purple crystalline egg with golden vein-like cracks rests on a wet, rocky alien shore. It is surrounded by smaller translucent bubbles, some with spikes, while colorful smoke and distant glowing orbs fill the twilight background.
